leadText:
Pokémon Live: A Pocketful of Adventures (Japanese: ポケットに をつめこんで Pack Your Pocket With Adventure), abbreviated as (Japanese: ポケつめ Pokétsume), is an original live-action drama based on the core series Pokémon games. It consists of 10 episodes, and stars as Madoka Akagi.

It aired on TV Tokyo in Japan during the timeslot every Friday at 12:30 AM from October 20 to December 22, 2023. In , the show was released with Traditional Chinese subtitles on the streaming platform beginning with the first two episodes on October 31, 2023, followed by a simulcast with the Japanese release. In , the show was aired with Korean subtitles on every Thursday from November 9, 2023 to January 11, 2024. In the , the show was streamed with English and Japanese audio and Arabic and English subtitles on Shahid (since rebranded as ) beginning on May 18, 2024. 

The series was announced on August 30, 2023. A 100-second trailer was posted on the official Twitter account on October 5, 2023.
plainText:
Pokémon Live: A Pocketful of Adventures (Japanese: ポケットに をつめこんで Pack Your Pocket With Adventure), abbreviated as (Japanese: ポケつめ Pokétsume), is an original live-action drama based on the core series Pokémon games. It consists of 10 episodes, and stars as Madoka Akagi.

It aired on TV Tokyo in Japan during the timeslot every Friday at 12:30 AM from October 20 to December 22, 2023. In , the show was released with Traditional Chinese subtitles on the streaming platform beginning with the first two episodes on October 31, 2023, followed by a simulcast with the Japanese release. In , the show was aired with Korean subtitles on every Thursday from November 9, 2023 to January 11, 2024. In the , the show was streamed with English and Japanese audio and Arabic and English subtitles on Shahid (since rebranded as ) beginning on May 18, 2024. 

The series was announced on August 30, 2023. A 100-second trailer was posted on the official Twitter account on October 5, 2023.

==Plot==
Madoka Akagi grew up in Mashiro, a port town in the . After graduating from a local university, she worked for a maker, but changed jobs to work for ADventure, a small advertising agency in , in order to become a creator, which she had longed to be since her school days. Madoka moved to Tokyo to pursue her dream, but reality was not so sweet. The glittering world she had imagined was not what she had in mind. In addition, she ends up taking on a presentation that holds the fate of the company in its hands. Then, Madoka receives a package from her mother. In it is a Game Boy and cartridge that she used to play as a child. She starts playing Pokemon Red for the first time in 20 years.

==Trivia==
On the Shahid website, the title "Pokemon Live: A Pocketful Of Adventures" is used in English, Arabic, and French. In the English subtitles, the title card is translated as "A Pocketful of Adventures" in episodes 1 and 2 and as "Pocket Adventure" in episodes 3–10. In the Arabic subtitles, it is translated as "مغامرات متنوعة" (Various Adventures) in all episodes except episode 3, where it is translated as "حفنة من المغامرات" (A Handful of Adventures).
